description: Shared Renovate policy for all silverbeer repos. See README.md for why each rule exists.

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One PR per ecosystem, not one per dependency. Forty separate bump PRs is how automation gets muted.
pre-commit hook revs move on their own schedule and are worth seeing separately — this is the class of drift that caused SB-432.
Patch and minor auto-merge on green CI. Majors are always read by a human.
Majors never auto-merge. separateMajorMinor at the top level keeps them in their own PR so the changelog is readable.
A formatter's output is its contract, so a surprise bump rewrites diffs. Never auto-merge one — see the ruff case in the README.
Python itself is a deliberate migration, not a dependency bump.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly window and the release-age wait.
